description: Participation Demographics Analytics Dashboard for Decidim 0.30 - Analyzes user demographics, geographic distribution, and participation patterns.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, (u.extended_data->>'date_of_birth')::date)) < 25 THEN '< 25'
    WHEN DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, (u.extended_data->>'date_of_birth')::date)) BETWEEN 25 AND 34 THEN '25-34'
    WHEN DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, (u.extended_data->>'date_of_birth')::date)) BETWEEN 35 AND 44 THEN '35-44'
    WHEN DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, (u.extended_data->>'date_of_birth')::date)) BETWEEN 45 AND 54 THEN '45-54'
    WHEN DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, (u.extended_data->>'date_of_birth')::date)) BETWEEN 55 AND 64 THEN '55-64'
    WHEN DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, (u.extended_data->>'date_of_birth')::date)) >= 65 THEN '65+'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END as age_group,
  COUNT(*) as value
FROM decidim_users u
WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.type = 'Decidim::User'
GROUP BY age_group
ORDER BY value DESC;

SELECT 'No Area' as area_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) as value
FROM decidim_users u
WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.type = 'Decidim::User'
GROUP BY area_name
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) as time,
  COUNT(*) as "New Registrations"
FROM decidim_users 
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 months' 
  AND deleted_at IS NULL 
  AND type = 'Decidim::User'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT 'No Area' as area_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) as total_users,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN c.decidim_author_id END) as active_users_30d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cp.decidim_proposal_id) as proposals_created,
  COUNT(DISTINCT comm.id) as comments_made,
  ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN c.decidim_author_id END) * 100.0) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT u.id), 0), 2) as activity_rate
FROM decidim_users u
LEFT JOIN decidim_coauthorships cp ON u.id = cp.decidim_author_id AND cp.decidim_author_type = 'Decidim::User'
LEFT JOIN decidim_comments_comments comm ON u.id = comm.decidim_author_id AND comm.decidim_author_type = 'Decidim::User' AND comm.deleted_at IS NULL
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT decidim_author_id, created_at FROM decidim_comments_comments WHERE decidim_author_type = 'Decidim::User' AND deleted_at IS NULL) c ON u.id = c.decidim_author_id
WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.type = 'Decidim::User'
GROUP BY area_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) > 0
ORDER BY total_users DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, (u.extended_data->>'date_of_birth')::date)) < 25 THEN '< 25'
    WHEN DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, (u.extended_data->>'date_of_birth')::date)) BETWEEN 25 AND 34 THEN '25-34'
    WHEN DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, (u.extended_data->>'date_of_birth')::date)) BETWEEN 35 AND 44 THEN '35-44'
    WHEN DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, (u.extended_data->>'date_of_birth')::date)) BETWEEN 45 AND 54 THEN '45-54'
    WHEN DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, (u.extended_data->>'date_of_birth')::date)) BETWEEN 55 AND 64 THEN '55-64'
    WHEN DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, (u.extended_data->>'date_of_birth')::date)) >= 65 THEN '65+'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END as age_group,
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) as total_users,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cp.decidim_proposal_id) as proposals_created,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as comments_made,
  ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(days FROM NOW() - u.last_sign_in_at)), 1) as avg_days_since_login
FROM decidim_users u
LEFT JOIN decidim_coauthorships cp ON u.id = cp.decidim_author_id AND cp.decidim_author_type = 'Decidim::User'
LEFT JOIN decidim_comments_comments c ON u.id = c.decidim_author_id AND c.decidim_author_type = 'Decidim::User' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.type = 'Decidim::User'
GROUP BY age_group
ORDER BY total_users DESC;

SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC('week', u.last_sign_in_at) as time,
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) as "Active Users"
FROM decidim_users u
WHERE u.last_sign_in_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 weeks' 
  AND u.deleted_at IS NULL 
  AND u.type = 'Decidim::User'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', u.last_sign_in_at)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT 
  ROUND(
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN u.last_sign_in_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 1 END) * 100.0) / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2
  ) as value
FROM decidim_users u
WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.type = 'Decidim::User';
